newsitem.title: USA: U.S. preparing for Clinton-Yeltsin summit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. preparing for Clinton-Yeltsin summit.

text.p: The White House wished Russian President Boris Yeltsin a speedy recovery on Tuesday and said preparations are continuing for a meeting between him and President Bill Clinton.

White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry acknowledged the scheduled March summit could be delayed because Yeltsin is recovering from a series of health problems. "He has been ill, we wished him well for a speedy recovery," he told reporters.

"We've done an enormous amount of work with the Russian Federation preparing for the summit that the president will have, and still expects to have, with President Yeltsin -- if not March, at a time and venue that is jointly agreed by both sides," McCurry said.
"We fully expect that summit to occur," he said. "We're preparing for it."
He said the summit's timing and location would be discussed next week when Vice President Al Gore and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin hold talks in Washington.
